palette.primary_role: Header text, navigation, footer (warm dark brown/navy instead of harsh black)
palette.accent_role: CTA buttons, service price highlights, decorative elements, badges, brand-specific accents (rose, teal, pink, green, blue, purple)
palette.surface_role: Page backgrounds, card backgrounds, alternating sections (warm cream/pink/cool white tones)
palette.neutral_role: Body text, service descriptions, secondary information
palette.border_role: Card borders, input fields, dividers (soft warm tones to clean gray)

button_styles.text: Learn More, Read Full Description, View All, Book a Facial

elevation.shadows: soft, diffused or none (many brands use flat design with no shadows)

typical_order: header (transparent or cream bg, centered logo, hamburger mobile, 'Book Now' pill CTA right for service brands)
hero (full-bleed serene interior photo + headline + subheadline + primary CTA + secondary 'View Services' — OR full-bleed product photography for ecommerce)
promo_banner (sticky top bar: coupon code, limited time offer, free shipping threshold — common in ecommerce beauty)
services_menu (grid or list: service category + items with names, durations, prices, descriptions — 'Book' button per item)
about_philosophy (short paragraph about the space/experience, owner/stylist photo, mission)
team (photo cards: staff headshot, name, role/specialty, short bio, Instagram handle)
product_grid (ecommerce: horizontal scroll rows or masonry grid, product image + name + price + quick-add CTA)
gallery (masonry or carousel: interior space, treatment rooms, product shots, before/after with consent)
reviews (testimonial cards: client name, star rating, quote about specific service/staff member, Google/Yelp source — or product reviews for ecommerce)
booking_cta (centered section: 'Ready to relax?' + booking widget or 'Book Now' button + phone number)
footer (3-4 column: about/location_hours/services + social links + newsletter signup or booking link)
hero_variants: full_bleed_interior (serene spa/salon photo, dark soft overlay, centered white headline — most common for service brands)
full_bleed_product (product/model photography, minimal overlay, headline + CTA bottom-left or centered — Glossier, Sephora)
split_right (text left with CTA + lifestyle/interior photo right)
video_ambient (slow-motion interior video loop: candles, massage table, products)
carousel_hero (rotating images: interior, treatment, product, team — auto-advance)
promo_hero (large coupon/offer text: '$30 off your first facial' — Heyday, '10% OFF YOUR FIRST ORDER' — Drybar)
service_card_variants: menu_list (clean list: service name, duration, price right-aligned, short description, 'Book' button)
image_card (service photo top, name + description below, price badge, book link)
category_grid (icon per service category, expandable to see individual services)
product_card_ecommerce (product image, brand name, product name, price, rating stars, quick-add button — Sephora, Drybar)
editorial_card (large photo, minimal text, lifestyle context — Glossier)
gallery_variants: masonry_grid (mixed-size photos: interior wide, treatment square, product portrait)
carousel (full-width horizontal scroll with arrow controls)
instagram_grid (beauty bar/nail studio: social-proof-first, embedded Instagram feed)

new_patterns_discovered.marching_ants_border: Glossier uses a distinctive animated dashed-border effect ('marching ants') on button hover — CSS background-size animation with 4-edge gradient. Signals 'in progress' for Add to Bag actions.
new_patterns_discovered.serif_sans_mix: Drybar pairs bold Mrs Eaves serif (headings, 45-90px) with Poppins sans-serif (body, 15px) — editorial magazine aesthetic applied to ecommerce.
new_patterns_discovered.navy_warm_cream_spa: Heyday uses #0f2a59 navy for ALL text (not black) on #fffcf8 warm white — no pure black anywhere, creating a uniquely soft, elevated spa feel.
new_patterns_discovered.tailwind_spa: Heyday is built on Shopify + Tailwind CSS — proving utility-first CSS works for premium spa brands when paired with custom typography and warm color palette.
new_patterns_discovered.custom_font_everywhere: All 4 scanned brands use custom/proprietary fonts: Sephora (Helvetica Neue system stack), Glossier (Apercu), Heyday (SunsetGothic), Drybar (Mrs Eaves + Poppins). No brand uses only Google Fonts.

tone_profile.headline_style: evocative and sensory (e.g., 'A sanctuary for your senses', 'Reveal your natural radiance', 'Where beauty meets tranquility', 'Don't mask oil. absorb it.' — Drybar, 'You look good' — Glossier)
tone_profile.cta_style: varies by sub-type: spa → gentle/inviting (Book Your Experience, Reserve Your Appointment); ecommerce → direct/casual (Shop Now, Add to Bag, Fetch the Look); service → benefit-driven (BOOK AND SAVE NOW — Heyday)
trust_signals: Google/Yelp star rating and review count
product brands used (Aveda, Dermalogica, Oribe, etc.)
featured in local publications / 'Best of' awards
product reviews with verified purchase badges (ecommerce)
anti_patterns: stock photos of models instead of real work/space
harsh or clinical color palette (unless medspa)
missing pricing (common trust breaker in beauty industry)
pure black (#000000) on pure white (#ffffff) for spa/wellness brands — too harsh; use warm charcoal or navy instead
generic system fonts without custom brand typography

navy_warm_cream (elevated spa: #fffcf8 warm cream bg, #0f2a59 navy text, SunsetGothic font, no pure black — per Heyday)
black_white_luxe (beauty ecommerce: #ffffff white bg, #000000 black text, pill buttons, bold accent colors, Helvetica Neue — per Sephora)
minimal_millennial_pink (DTC beauty: #ffffff white bg, pink brand identity, Apercu font, 0px border-radius, editorial photography — per Glossier)
playful_serif_lemon (haircare ecommerce: #ffffff bg, #42413d warm charcoal text, #004243 teal headings, #ffdd30 lemon accent, Mrs Eaves serif + Poppins — per Drybar)
typography_mood: elegant_serif (Playfair Display headings — spa, luxury, refined)
minimal_sans (Josefin Sans + Inter — modern medspa, clean, geometric)
warm_editorial (Lora headings + Nunito body — accessible, cozy, neighborhood salon)

menu_efficient (salon: service list prominent, booking always visible)

editorial_air (DTC: large photos, minimal text, storytelling scroll, white space heavy — Glossier)

service_detail.best_practices: Detailed description of treatment, what to expect, prep instructions, aftercare, FAQ

booking_page.best_practices: Minimal steps (3 max), show availability clearly, allow staff preference, send confirmation

ecommerce_plp.best_practices: Sticky filter bar, quick-add to cart, product badges (NEW, SALE, BESTSELLER), brand logos

ecommerce_pdp.best_practices: Multiple product images/videos, ingredient transparency, before/after photos, review integration
